sourcePolicy: Normalization artifacts define canonical semantic display forms across approved core, reference, slideshow and full-view layers without changing mathematical meaning.
rules: All four approved lesson layers and versions must be recorded.
Lexical and spacing variants may map to one canonical display form.
Semantic conflicts must block final integration.
Formula IDs must remain stable and no new mathematics may be introduced.
Ordered family, column matrix, coordinate column and transform direction must remain distinct.
Units and norm-versus-norm-squared labels must remain unambiguous.
Layout rules must be semantic and may not contain CSS, pixels, JavaScript or animation directives.
Approved source artifacts must not be rewritten solely for cosmetic spacing differences.
Reader Pro and E235 remain unchanged during normalization.
